action.title: Resize img partition
action.set:
project=$(cat $TMPDIR/DNA.ini) DNA_PRO=$DNA_DIR/$project DNA_OUT=$DNA_PRO/out
# Ensure output folder exists mkdir -p "$DNA_OUT"
# Loop through selected images for img_file in $(echo "$img" | tr ',' '\n'); do echo "Resizing $DNA_PRO/$img_file with +${extra_size}MB"
# Append zero bytes to increase size dd if=/dev/zero bs=1M count="$extra_size" >> "$DNA_PRO/$img_file"
# Resize filesystem on the image resize2fs "$DNA_PRO/$img_file" || echo "Warning: resize2fs failed on $img_file"
# Copy resized image to output folder cp -f "$DNA_PRO/$img_file" "$DNA_OUT/$img_file" echo "Output copied to $DNA_OUT/$img_file" done

param.name: img
param.title: Select .img files to resize:
param.desc: Detects .img files under /sdcard/DNA project path

action.title: Core patch - DSV
action.desc: Enables direct installation of system applications by bypassing complete signature verification
action.set: if [ "$android_version" = "A13+" ]; then chmod +x "$START_DIR/tools/dsv_a13+" "$START_DIR/tools/dsv_a13+" elif [ "$android_version" = "A15+" ]; then chmod +x "$START_DIR/tools/dsv_a15+" "$START_DIR/tools/dsv_a15+" "$disable_invoke_custom" fi

param.name: android_version
param.title: Select Android Version:
param.desc: Choose Android version

param.name: disable_invoke_custom
param.label: Remove invoke-custom
param.desc: Disables invoke-custom usage in equals, hashCode, and toString smali methods. Only applicable to Android 15+.

action.title: Remove Apk Protection
action.desc: Disables built-in APK protection in stock ROMs, allowing seamless replacement of modified system applications
action.set: if [ "$android_version" = "A13+" ]; then chmod +x "$START_DIR/tools/apk_protection_a13+" "$START_DIR/tools/apk_protection_a13+" elif [ "$android_version" = "A15+" ]; then chmod +x "$START_DIR/tools/apk_protection_a15+" "$START_DIR/tools/apk_protection_a15+" "$disable_invoke_custom" fi

action.desc: This removes the screenshots and screenrecords limits for all applications. Normally, special applications are replaced with black areas in records. This can be convenient in some cases but may lead to privacy leaks.
